rounds.title: Atomic transfer
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Move selected identities between lists in one deterministic transition.
constraints: Move only selected source items to the target list.
Preserve the relative order of moved and existing items.
Clear moved selections after a successful transfer.
Disable transfer actions when their source has no selection.

rounds.title: Bidirectional consistency
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Apply the same identity rules in both directions and reject no-op transitions.
constraints: Move-left is the inverse of move-right for the selected IDs.
An item can exist in exactly one list at a time.
No-op actions do not reorder lists or change selection.
Use stable item IDs rather than display labels or array indexes.

frameworkTests.name: Round 2 · Item can return without duplication

rounds.title: Bulk boundaries
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Make multi-selection deterministic under alternating moves.
constraints: Transfer every selected item exactly once in source order.
A second action during the same state cannot duplicate items.
Selections belong to their source list and never cross list ownership.
Render an accurate item count for each list after every transition.

frameworkTests.name: Round 3 · Two selected identities move in source order

rounds.title: Accessible transfer workflow
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Expose list ownership, action direction, and completed moves to assistive technology.
constraints: Give both lists distinct accessible names and group each row with its checkbox label.
Give transfer controls directional accessible names independent of arrow glyphs.
Announce the number and direction of moved items in a polite status region.

frameworkTests.name: Round 4 · Direction and result are announced
